newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CorpGro details cost of signs group buys.
newsitem.headline: CorpGro details cost of signs group buys.

text.p: South Africa's CorpGro Ltd on Wednesday detailed the possible costs of its buy of the Rent-a-Sign group of outdoor advertising firms.

The deal, which was announced in February, will cost a maximum of 30 million rand if combined profit from newly-formed CorpGro advertising unit CorpCom reaches 21.6 million rand in 1998 and 26 million rand in 1999.
It will cost only one million rand if CorpCom profit for 1998 is less than 12.9 million rand.
CorpCom has been formed as the new media unit of CorpGro and companies in that sector acquired by the parent group will be placed in the division.
